title: Make README usage guide explicit
description: README should be very clear about installation, linking, basic usage, paragraph lists, highlights, menu actions, ranges/footnotes, Expo dev builds, and platform limitations.
acceptance_criteria: README has a clear step-by-step usage guide with copy-paste examples and warnings about app-owned workflows and native testing.
close_reason: Expanded README with install, Expo dev-build, mental model, examples, menu actions, highlights, footnote ranges, multilingual segments, FlatList paragraphs, and platform notes.

title: Compile and run native example builds
description: Generate native example projects and compile/run available iOS and Android targets to catch native compile/runtime issues.
acceptance_criteria: Expo example native projects are generated; available iOS/Android builds are run or blockers are documented; native compile errors are fixed.
close_reason: Generated Expo native projects and verified Android assembleDebug and iOS simulator xcodebuild. iOS required a local generated Podfile fmt C++17 workaround for this Xcode/RN toolchain.

title: Scope iOS custom menu behavior to ReaderText views
description: Current iOS implementation writes custom items to UIMenuController.shared, which can affect unrelated text views. Scope custom actions to ReaderText's UITextView and modernize where practical.
acceptance_criteria: Custom menu actions are only available for ReaderText's own text view; default Copy remains available; docs note platform differences.
close_reason: Scoped iOS custom menu actions to ReaderText's UITextView via buildMenu instead of mutating UIMenuController.shared; default copy remains native.

title: Fix iOS clearSelection command export
description: JS dispatches clearSelection as a native view command, but the iOS implementation exports it as an RCT_EXTERN_METHOD. Align the imperative handle or remove the unsupported handle.
acceptance_criteria: ReaderTextHandle.clearSelection works on iOS and Android or is removed from the public API/docs; typecheck/build pass.
close_reason: Removed unsupported clearSelection handle/command from the public API and native exports; typecheck/build/native checks pass.

title: Verify MVP build, tests, and consumer-readiness
description: Run the checks needed before testing the library in a separate consumer project.
acceptance_criteria: Typecheck, lint/tests where configured, Android build, iOS pod/build sanity checks, and example app smoke tests are run or documented if unavailable; package entrypoints and peer dependencies are checked; no commit or push is made without explicit approval.
notes: Verification passed: npm test -- --runInBand (14 tests, 100% coverage on src/utils.ts), npm run typecheck, npm run build, npm pack --dry-run, pod ipc spec react-native-reader-text.podspec, example npm install, and example npm run typecheck. Native device/simulator builds were not run in this shell; Android gradle executable was not installed and example native projects were not generated.
close_reason: Available automated verification completed; native runtime testing remains for host app/dev build.

title: Write README and focused docs
description: Turn the spec into public-facing README and docs that explain the library's scope, installation, usage, platform notes, and contribution path.
acceptance_criteria: README covers positioning, why native views, TextInput tradeoffs, install, basic usage, custom menu usage, highlights, multilingual segments, Expo development build note, platform support, and contributor invitation; docs cover selection, highlights, typography, and Expo.
notes: Rewrote README and added docs for selection, highlights, typography, and Expo. Docs include generic app-owned workflow boundary and example instructions.
close_reason: README and focused docs completed.

title: Emit selection callbacks with UTF-16 offsets and anchors
description: Report logical selected text and UTF-16 start/end offsets from native selection, plus a selection anchor rectangle for app-owned popovers.
acceptance_criteria: onSelection and menu events include selected text, start, end; offsets match the concatenated logical string; anchor uses window coordinates with zero fallback when unavailable; docs state UTF-16 behavior and platform differences.
notes: Implemented native selection callbacks with selected text, logical UTF-16 start/end offsets, and best-effort window-coordinate anchors for menu action events.
close_reason: Selection callbacks and anchors implemented.

title: Add native custom selection menu items
description: Add app-provided custom items to the native selection menu for ReaderText's own native views.
acceptance_criteria: menuItems { id, title }[] appear in native selection UI where supported; tapping an item emits onMenuAction with id, title, selection, and anchor; default Copy is preserved where possible; menu ordering/platform limitations are documented; implementation is scoped to ReaderText views.
notes: Implemented structured custom selection menu items on Android and iOS. Events include id, title, selection, and anchor; Copy remains handled by the platform where available.
close_reason: Native custom selection menu item hooks implemented.

title: Render highlight ranges natively
description: Apply highlight ranges to the logical text via native attributed strings/spans.
acceptance_criteria: Valid highlights render on iOS and Android; invalid ranges are ignored safely; overlapping ranges do not crash and are documented as last-applied-wins for v1; highlight IDs pass through unchanged.
notes: Implemented native highlight rendering with Android BackgroundColorSpan and iOS NSAttributedString backgroundColor. JS filters invalid ranges before native props.
close_reason: Highlight range rendering implemented on both native platforms.

title: Implement iOS UITextView rendering and selectable text
description: Build the iOS native view using UITextView configured as read-only selectable text.
acceptance_criteria: ReaderText renders text on iOS using UITextView; isEditable=false, selectable follows prop, scroll disabled by default, transparent background and zero text container padding; supports style/textStyle basics; works in the example app.
notes: Implemented iOS ReaderTextView using UITextView configured as read-only selectable text with attributed strings, highlights, menu actions, selection events, anchors, ranges, direction, and segment typography.
close_reason: iOS native UITextView implementation completed.

title: Define public TypeScript API and JS utilities
description: Implement ReaderText props/types and small JS utilities for text normalization, segment concatenation, highlight validation, and typography profile merging.
acceptance_criteria: ReaderText exports compile; text vs segments precedence is defined; ranges are validated as UTF-16 offsets; focused unit tests cover concatenation, invalid ranges, and typography merging.
notes: Implemented ReaderText public types, component wrapper, native prop bridge, imperative handle, and tested utilities for logical text, ranges, highlights, selections, segments, and typography merging.
close_reason: Public TypeScript API and JS utility tests implemented.

title: Implement Android TextView rendering and selectable text
description: Build the Android native view using TextView, not EditText, with read-only selectable text and basic styling support.
acceptance_criteria: ReaderText renders text on Android with selectable true/false behavior; uses TextView#setTextIsSelectable; supports style/textStyle basics; does not show editing keyboard; works in the example app.
notes: Implemented Android ReaderTextView using TextView with selectable read-only text, styles, highlights, custom menu items, selection events, anchors, ranges, direction, and segment typography spans.
close_reason: Android native TextView implementation completed.

title: Scaffold React Native library project
description: Create the package structure for react-native-reader-text using the repo's chosen React Native library scaffold.
acceptance_criteria: package.json, TypeScript config, src exports, android and ios native component folders, example app, README, CONTRIBUTING, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, and docs stubs exist; no publishing or pushing is performed.
close_reason: Scaffolded package, TypeScript/Jest setup, native folders, podspec, Android Gradle config, docs/contributing stubs, and Expo example app structure.

title: Decision: keep ReaderText generic and app-owned workflows external
description: ReaderText should own native text rendering, selection, menu hooks, anchors, highlights, and typography. Consumer apps own note models, color pickers, share sheets, persistence, analytics, sync, and domain-specific IDs.
acceptance_criteria: The spec and README present ReaderText as a generic primitive; no built-in note/share/highlight workflow UI or storage is added to v1.
notes: Implementation boundary confirmed in spec: ReaderText owns generic native rendering/selection/menu/ranges/highlights/typography; apps own workflows and storage.
close_reason: Decision captured in spec and implementation plan.

title: Decision: use structured custom menu items
description: Use menuItems as { id, title }[] and emit { id, title, selection, anchor } from onMenuAction instead of comparing display strings.
acceptance_criteria: Types and examples use structured menu items; translated or duplicate titles do not affect action identity; anchor is included for app-owned popovers.
notes: Structured menuItems API is in the spec: { id, title }[] with onMenuAction emitting id, title, selection, and anchor.
close_reason: Decision captured in spec and planned API.

title: MVP: native selectable ReaderText
description: Deliver the first usable version of react-native-reader-text: a small native read-only selectable text primitive for React Native readers.
acceptance_criteria: A consumer can install the package, render selectable read-only text on iOS and Android, add custom native selection menu items, receive UTF-16 logical ranges, render highlights, use multilingual segments, and follow README/example docs.
notes: MVP implementation completed locally: scaffold, TS API, native iOS/Android views, highlights, selection/menu anchors, ranges, multilingual typography, example app, README/docs, and automated checks.
close_reason: All child Beads tasks under the MVP epic are closed.

title: Align multilingual line-height behavior with spec
description: Spec suggests using the maximum line-height requirement for mixed-script paragraphs. Current native code applies line height per segment.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation either uses paragraph-wide max line height for segments or docs/spec explicitly state v1 per-segment behavior; tests/docs updated.
close_reason: Implemented paragraph-wide max line-height multiplier across segments on JS, Android, and iOS, with utility test coverage and README docs.

title: Design footnote extension points without owning footnote UI
description: Decide how ReaderText should support app-owned footnote behavior through ranges, metadata, and callbacks without parsing documents or rendering footnote sheets itself.
acceptance_criteria: Spec and README document that v1 does not parse/render footnotes, but apps can represent footnote markers as text/segments and handle marker taps via generic range callbacks or future marker APIs.
notes: Footnotes are app-owned in v1. Spec adds generic ReaderTextRange/ranges/onRangePress extension point without footnote parsing/storage/UI.
close_reason: Decision captured in spec as generic range extension point.

title: Build example app screens and manual test cases
description: Create example screens that exercise the library as a consumer would, including dozens of paragraph-level ReaderText components.
acceptance_criteria: Example includes English, Arabic, Urdu, mixed RTL/LTR, highlights, custom menu actions, long paragraphs, and FlatList with multiple ReaderText instances; manual testing matrix is documented for simulator/device, RTL settings, accessibility font size, and dark mode.
notes: Added Expo development-build example screen demonstrating selectable text, custom menu actions, highlights, app-owned footnote/range handling, multilingual segments, and a FlatList with many paragraph-level ReaderText instances.
close_reason: Example app screen and manual test cases implemented.

title: Support multilingual segments, typography, and bidi direction
description: Render segments as one logical string while applying per-segment language/font/scale/baseline attributes and native bidi direction.
acceptance_criteria: segments take precedence over text; highlights and selection offsets apply to concatenated logical text; typography profiles merge with segment overrides; baseDirection maps to native LTR/RTL/auto behavior; no manual string reversal is used.
notes: Implemented segments as concatenated logical text with normalized offsets; native platforms apply per-segment typography profiles, baseline offsets, line-height multipliers, and base direction mapping.
close_reason: Multilingual segments, typography, and bidi direction implemented.
